verdict.rationale: The pack documents no async or batch ingestion API and no way to check the status of background memory operations. Dreaming [letta-docs-27] does update memory in the background, but it is automatic consolidation of conversations, not user-driven ingestion at scale, and nothing shows its status can be queried. Headless mode [letta-docs-4] is a scripting interface, not batch memory ingestion, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can ingest at scale with async or batch processing and check the status of background memory operations
